name: Is it possible to finance repairs for a foreclosed property?

mainEntity.name: Is it possible to finance repairs for a foreclosed property?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, several financing options exist for foreclosed property repairs. These include FHA 203(k) loans, Fannie Mae HomeStyle Renovation loans, or conventional renovation loans, which combine the purchase price and repair costs into one mortgage. Home equity loans or lines of credit might also be options if you already own other property. Consult with a lender to understand the best options for your situation.
